name: efforts increment: commit by explicit pathspec (3 files + 1 hunk) — recurrence, browsers, voice and the vue3-virtual-scroller major bump stay out
description:
Raised by PM in shift 5 (2026-11-18T16:33Z) from a measurement of the working tree. This replaces the vague step "commit the efforts work" in milestone M1, which was never scoped.

WHY: `git status` vs HEAD is 65 changed files in `src/` + `tests/`, +2219/-221. It mixes at least four unrelated in-flight features (browsers/volume mappings, chat find bar, voice, the recurrence UI in TaskSettings.vue) with the efforts increment. Committing that as one commit destroys the increment's only real property: that it can be deployed, demoed and reverted on its own. It also hides the efforts work from review inside 2200 lines nobody will read.

EXACT PATHS TO COMMIT (the whole efforts increment):
1. `src/api/modules/efforts.js`                 (+8/-3)   behaviour change
2. `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` (+8/-1)  remove() fix — card fcf65219
3. `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`                  (A, +139) 9 cases — card d4e3a041
4. `package.json` — ONLY the `"test": "node --test tests/"` hunk (+1 line at :14).

DELIBERATELY OUT OF THIS COMMIT:
- `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` (+123/-0) = the RECURRENCE feature, a different increment. Do not commit it here.
- `package.json` hunk 2: `vue3-virtual-scroller ^0.2.3 -> ^2.0.3`, an unowned MAJOR dependency bump. Stage the test-script hunk only (`git add -p package.json`) and leave the bump dirty.
- every browsers/ chat/ voice/ volumeMappings file, and the untracked `tests/voice*.test.mjs` suites.

ORDER (hard): 91411767 (node runtime) -> 675c4695 (delete the 3 HTML-comment lines, else the CISO gate blocks on scope=all) -> a0f362ed (9 ok lines posted) -> this commit. Do not commit before the 9 `ok -` lines exist: an unverified behaviour change in a commit is the exact thing this increment exists to prevent.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `git show --stat HEAD` lists exactly the 4 paths above, nothing else.
- `git diff HEAD -- package.json` still shows the vue3-virtual-scroller bump as UNcommitted (proof the hunk split worked).
- The commit message names the 3 cards (fcf65219, d4e3a041, 91411767).
- Post the full `git show --stat HEAD` output as evidence on this card.

PM shift 5 (2026-11-18T16:33Z) — **paths confirmed against the tree, and here is the exact hunk-split recipe so this does not stall tomorrow.** Read before you start.

2. `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` — modified **+8/-1**  ← note the real folder: `global_settings`, not `kanban`
3. `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` — added **+139/-0**
4. `package.json` — **hunk 1 ONLY** (`"test": "node --test tests/"` at line 14)

Explicitly **NOT** in this commit:
- `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` (+123/-0) — that is the **recurrence** feature. My earlier note implied it might be in scope; it is not. Leaving it out also means the HIGH hidden-comment finding is **not** in this commit, so this card is no longer blocked by `675c4695`.
- the `vue3-virtual-scroller ^0.2.3 -> ^2.0.3` line in `package.json` (line 64) — same file, different hunk, must stay uncommitted.
- the 6 `tests/voice*.test.mjs` files.

Hunk-split, non-interactive (`git add -p` will not work in a tool shell):
```
git add src/api/modules/efforts.js src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue tests/effortsApi.test.mjs
git diff HEAD -- package.json > /tmp/pkg.patch   # inspect: two hunks (@@ -13,0 +14 @@ and @@ -63 +64 @@)
# delete the @@ -63 +64 @@ hunk from /tmp/pkg.patch, keep the @@ -13,0 +14 @@ one
git apply --cached /tmp/pkg.patch
git diff --cached --stat        # MUST list exactly the 4 paths above
git commit -m "efforts: fix delete() resolution, unit-test the client API module (fcf65219, d4e3a041, 91411767)"
```
Acceptance (unchanged, plus one): `git show --stat HEAD` lists exactly those 4 paths; `git diff HEAD -- package.json` still contains the vue3-virtual-scroller bump; post both outputs as evidence on this card.

**Do not commit if the test run has not happened.** Without check 5 of the 12:00Z gate (9 `ok -` lines) the commit is not deployable-with-proof — report back instead.

## Measured before you commit (2026-11-19 shift, `fcf65219` evidence)

The efforts diff this card is meant to commit is, as of now, exactly:

`project_changes(scope="all", paths=["src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue", "src/api/modules/efforts.js", "tests/effortsApi.test.mjs"])` → **3 files, +19/-9**

- `src/api/modules/efforts.js` **+8/-3** — `delete()` returns `API.delete(...)` instead of swallowing it.
- `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` **+8/-1** — `remove()` drops `assertOk`, inspects `deleted.status_code`, reloads on success.
- `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` **+3/-5** — last assertion flips to `delete() === envelope` (line 126).

Two things for the commit itself:
1. Use those three paths as the pathspec and nothing else — the tree holds ~60 other modified files from unrelated work, none of them in this diff.
2. The behaviour of `remove()` is **still unproven**: `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` cannot run in this runtime (no shell, `91411767`). The change is internally consistent (test ↔ implementation cross-checked line by line on `fcf65219`), so committing it is defensible, but do not record it as "verified" — record it as "static review only, behavioural check pending". If you need a green run before shipping, defer to `a0f362ed` (12:30Z) rather than committing on my evidence.
